snippet.title: Sloppy Forgeries - Official Gameplay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Sloppy Forgeries, a fast-paced competitive painting game developed by Playful Systems. Players will practice their skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time. Sloppy Forgeries is coming soon to PC (Steam).
